answer: Audits are written down in reef, queued in walnut, and jetty publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 95 identities per epoch. A farm of 274 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2628 identities would post 3342 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
